title: The buddy's buttons — clearer pictures for three of them

steps.path: The button row beside the buddy, first button
steps.headline: Which picture best says "put a picture of my screen into this chat"?
steps.notice: Only the first button changes on this slide; the other three stay as they are today. Pictures are three times real size.

variants.label: Today's camera
variants.summary: The camera as it is now. Reads as "take a photo", not "of my screen".

variants.label: Capture corners
variants.summary: Four corners around a dot, like a phone's screenshot or scan mark. The common picture for "capture what's on screen".

variants.label: Screen with corners
variants.summary: A computer screen with capture corners inside it. Says "my screen" most directly.
variants.risk: The busiest of the three; the corners are small at real size.

variants.label: Tidied camera
variants.summary: The same camera idea, redrawn with cleaner, rounder lines. Keeps what people already learned.

steps.path: The button row beside the buddy, third button
steps.headline: Which picture best says "open the full YouCoded window"?
steps.notice: Only the third button changes on this slide. The second button (bigger or smaller chat) stays as it is.

variants.label: Today's window
variants.summary: A small window with an arrow cut into its corner. Cramped, and close to the size button's arrows.

variants.label: Open elsewhere
variants.summary: A box with an arrow leaving it: the usual "opens somewhere else" mark on websites and apps.

variants.label: App window
variants.summary: A plain window with a title bar. Says "the app's window" without an arrow.
variants.risk: Doesn't say "open"; it could read as "a new window".

variants.label: House
variants.summary: A house: "go back to the main app". The simplest shape of the three.
variants.risk: Some apps use a house for a start page, not a whole window.

steps.path: The button row beside the buddy, last button
steps.headline: Which picture best says "hide the buddy until I bring him back"?
steps.notice: Hiding puts him away until the app restarts or you switch him back on in Settings. Only the last button changes on this slide.

variants.label: Today's crossed eye
variants.summary: The crossed-out eye as it is now, with slightly uneven lines.

variants.label: Tidied crossed eye
variants.summary: The same "not visible" eye, redrawn evenly. The standard picture for "hide".

variants.label: Tuck away
variants.summary: An arrow going down onto a line: "put him down out of the way".
variants.risk: Is also the usual picture for "download".

variants.label: Cross
variants.summary: A plain X. Everyone knows it means "go away".
variants.risk: Could read as "close the chat" rather than "hide the buddy".
